mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(scheduled_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN result = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled FROM rec_interview WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM rec_interview WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN (3, 5) AND scheduled_time >= #{date} AND scheduled_time < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC
SELECT * FROM rec_interview WHERE deleted = 0 AND status NOT IN (3, 5) AND scheduled_time >= #{startDate} AND scheduled_time < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY scheduled_time ASC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(i.scheduled_time) = CURDATE() AND i.deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayInterviews, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 2 AND i.deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rec_interview_assessment a WHERE a.interview_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS aiAssessed, COALESCE( ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 2 AND i.result = 0 AND i.deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 2 AND i.deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1 ), 0 ) AS passRate FROM rec_interview i WHERE i.deleted = 0

SELECT i.id AS interview_id, i.candidate_id AS candidate_id, i.candidate_name AS candidate_name, i.job_title AS job_title, jp.department_id AS department_id, a.overall_score AS overall_score, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(a.create_time, i.update_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS assessed_at FROM rec_interview i LEFT JOIN rec_interview_assessment a ON a.interview_id = i.id LEFT JOIN `smart_recruit_recruitment`.`rec_job_position` jp ON jp.id = i.job_position_id AND jp.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status != 3 ORDER BY COALESCE(a.create_time, i.update_time) DESC
